what: Instead of scrolling the document, it moves between sections stacked on screen via stations — wheel (Δ×.0014) and push (Δ×.0048) move the target by at most ±.35 at once, within ±1.3 of the current station, and 200ms after release it snaps to the nearest station from the spot .38 further in the direction it was pushed, then locks for 450ms. Position follows each frame by 1 − e^(−1.4·dt). For each section, opacity is written as 1 − smoothstep(|distance|, .12, .4)·--drift(distance) from the distance to the station, adding is-in above .6 and removing it below .45. Arrow keys·PageUp/Down·Space·Home/End move one step at a time, and a data-dive-go link farther than 1.5 steps is covered by a curtain over .22s power2.in, jumps to the station just before, then walks over .55s power2.out.

options.wheel: Shift per wheel notch Δ, default .0014
options.touch: Shift per push Δ (opposite direction), default .0048
options.step: Max that can be pushed at once, default .35
options.reach: Distance that can be pushed from the current stop, default 1.3
options.bias: Share of extra movement toward the direction it was pushed when attached, default .38
options.fade-out: Distance at which all hide, default .4
options.veil-in: Curtain cover time when skipping (sec), default .22
options.hold: When true, input is ignored until the entrance and intro finish — release with el.kfStationDive.hold(false)
options.ignore: Spot that does not take input (Observer ignore), default form

use: <main data-fx="station-dive"><section data-fx-part="station" data-key="hero">…</section><section data-fx-part="station" data-key="works" data-stations="7">…</section></main> · Link <a data-dive-go="works:2"> · The scene reads el.kfStationDive.pos (0 to station count−1) to set camera and color, and when the station changes, fx:station (detail.index · key · sub) is fired

from.where: index.html main[data-fx=station-dive] — original Observer(wheel,touch · tolerance 4) 13 stations (one work section has 7 stops), section opacity smoothstep(.12,.4)·--drift × depth −64px

note: Dragging is the whole job of this part (fixed-screen section paging), so it blocks default touch scrolling — use it only on one-page layouts where the panel covers the entire screen. To push text inside a section differently by depth, use translateY(var(--drift) × depth × −64px) on [data-depth]. The skip-blocking layer is painted with --kf-bg.
